description: This file defines synchronization utilities for managing API locks, including thread-local flags, lock guards, and registration functions for API methods within the Utils::Synchro namespace. It facilitates thread-safe API calls and deadlock prevention in a multi-threaded environment.

classes.name: ApiLocks
classes.description: Template struct that maintains a static recursive_mutex for each class type to ensure thread-safe API locking.

classes.name: UnlockApiGuard
classes.description: Template guard class that unlocks the API mutex upon construction if the thread is using the locked API, and re-locks it upon destruction.

classes.name: LockApiGuard
classes.description: Template class that manages a unique_lock for the class-specific mutex, providing explicit lock and unlock methods.

methods.name: getFunctionToCall
methods.description: Creates a std::function that wraps a method call with mutex locking and exception handling, setting a thread-local flag during execution.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApi
methods.description: Registers a method with the JSONRPC system, associating it with a specific object and method, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForVersions
methods.description: Registers a method with versioning support, associating it with an object and method for thread-safe RPC calls.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForHandler
methods.description: Registers a method with a JSONRPC handler, enabling thread-safe method invocation.
